name: Medic des Confins
description: Survivant solitaire des confins de la galaxie, Medic des Confins ne doit allégeance à aucune faction. Ancien membre de la Légion ou simple nomade, il parcourt les débris spatiaux avec pour seule loi sa propre survie.

subject.archetype: Scrap-Punk Medic Scout - Battle-worn independent reconnaissance specialist serving the Ferrailleurs de la Ceinture, clad in improvised survival suit markings them as both healer and survivor

loadout.armor_outfit: Heavily patched mining space suit in oxidized steel gray and rust orange, asymmetrical plating salvaged from old cargo container panels, thick tactical underlayer stained with engine grease and burn marks. Chest rig festooned with medical pouches made from welded metal containers, duct-tape wrapped around joints and seams. Scavenged welding helmet modified with cracked tinted visor, scratched sensor array attachment on left side. Heavy canvas and kevlar blend with exposed rivets, cracked rubber seals, cable harnesses crisscrossing torso with carabiners and tool clips. Rust-stained kneepads and elbow guards from scrapped industrial equipment. Gas mask with improvised filter canister welded to side.
loadout.arsenal: Hybrid plasma cutter/medical stabilizer tool raised in right hand (industrial weapon with exposed copper coils, jury-rigged battery pack strapped with electrical tape), worn impact pistol holstered at right thigh. Left arm mounted with repurposed mining scanner array showing faint blue holographic readouts through damaged casing. Multiple scalpels, trauma shears, and welding rods shoved into magnetized chest pockets. Improvised concussion grenade hanging from left shoulder harness.

attitude.behavior: Crouched behind corroded corrugated metal barricade, weight balanced on balls of feet ready to spring, left arm extended forward with active scanner array sweeping horizon. Right arm holding plasma tool at low-ready position, finger off trigger but ready. Head tilted slightly, cracked visor angled toward advancing enemy silhouettes through thick smoke. Knees bent, core engaged, slight lean forward, coiled energy despite exhaustion. One boot planted on debris for rapid cover-to-cover movement.
attitude.emotion: Tense focus beneath cracked visor, eyes scanning threat vectors through scratched plasma-blue sensor display. Jaw set tight, grime-covered face showing grim determination mixed with controlled adrenaline. Scarred hands steady on improvised weapon, breath regulated behind gas mask filter. Underlying urgency - medic's instinct to stabilize wounded fighting against scout's instinct to report and withdraw.

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic rim lighting with harsh blue-white plasma impact highlights, volumetric smoke fog with orange fire glow from distant explosions, flickering emergency lights casting intermittent shadows across corrugated walls
color_and_light.mood: Chaotic desperation, tense survival, gritty determination amid industrial destruction

camera.angle: Low angle dutch tilt slightly, positioned at ground level behind barricade looking up at subject, emphasizing power dynamic and imminent threat approaching through smoke

scenography.setting: Asteroid waystation crossroads junction - corroded interconnected shipping container modules, bent corrugated metal walls with exposed insulation, welded grating floors, salvaged docking clamps as barricades. Debris field visible through shattered viewport behind subject. Smoke-filled corridors with distant muzzle flashes and plasma discharge glow illuminating approaching enemy silhouettes.
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Thick gray-white smoke rolling through scene, bright plasma blue impact bursts creating small fireballs against metal walls, sparks and molten debris raining down, sparks showering from damaged overhead pipes, emergency red-amber warning lights pulsing intermittently, dust particles catching plasma glow, heat distortion from nearby weapon impacts, screen-space bloom on all light sources
